_about: The data as it will stand after case 2 lands (one row), simulated locally on 2026-11-13 (S639: review an apply against the data as it will stand afterward). Written by hand from the run named in `how`.
how: Simulated, not applied: a copy of kb/ took the cohort's one row (kb/_reclustering_s648_apply.py --overlay, the latest row winning reviewed_by as the real sync does), then export_unified_courses() ran on it through its UC_KB_DIR / UC_OUT_DIR seam; the same run on the untouched kb/ reproduced the committed unified_courses_*.js except their timestamps. Identities 49,561 to 49,560 (FIRE M1274 folds away); member rows 134,485 before and after, so no course counts twice. Only FIRE 130 X's and FIRE M1274's members changed and only their two in-browser rows differ. kb/_row_audit.py then ran on the laid-over state and on the untouched state in the same session.
display_notes: FIRE 130 X: members 23 to 51 and units 3 to 3-4 (FIRE M1274's 28 members join, Mt. San Jacinto FIRE 515 among them by map@rccd.edu's saved pointer); title kept. Eligible credits 667.4 to 1,022.4 and students 48 to 58: four credential titles new to the row, each recommending '3 hours in Building Construction for Fire Protection' (Fire Academy Experience 295.0 credits and 10 students; Professional Fire Service Experience 42.0; Firefighter I 18.0; SFT Fire Inspector 1B and 1C 0.0), as sound as the Firefighter 1 certification already on the row. Confidence reads 0.847 (none before); the evidence lane's FIRE 130 X group (score 10) closes, 164 to 163.
The adopter and potential college lists stay 5 and 6: FIRE M1274 has no entry in kb/coci_articulations.json identities, so the rollup skips it (a lane follow-up: rebuild the identities map).

Row audit, against a same-session baseline: one card differs. FIRE 130 X gains a merge-target card (kind X, faculty 0.97 ready, MC 0.679 needs_review, tags none, a suggested aggregate_from_members fix); totals 27,581 to 27,582 cards, ready 5,026 to 5,027, MC needs_review 1,709 to 1,710. FIRE M1274's card is unchanged.
